exclusions.source_text: creatinine clearance \>45 ml/min (by Cockcroft-Gault estimate or 24-hr creatinine clearance measurement)
total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 institutional upper limit of normal (ULN).
Participants with a history of prior malignancy will be eligible if all treatment of that malignancy was completed at least 2 years before registration
exclusions.threshold: treatment completed at least 2 years before registration

exclusions.source_text: Patients with HIV may be enrolled if they are on stable antiretroviral therapy, have an undetectable viral load, and CD4 count \> 250 cells/mm3.

Uncontrolled underlying cardiac conditions including but not limited to: congestive heart failure grade III or IV (by NYHA) or EF \< 45%, unstable angina pectoris, acute myocardial infarction \< 6 months, uncontrolled cardiac arrhythmia
exclusions.threshold: NYHA grade III or IV; EF < 45%; acute MI < 6 months

exclusions.source_text: Patients with known or suspected CNS involvement or leptomeningeal disease (i.e. BingNeel Syndrome) are excluded
Pregnant or breastfeeding women or participants unwilling to adhere to institutional guidelines for highly effective contraception for the duration of the therapy are excluded.
